text:
Alex K: Quick sync — we need to schedule a 30-45m inference benchmark + optimization readout next week. Goal: review latency + cost dashboards, surface regressions, and decide next actions for quant/batching rollouts. Who needs to be there?

Maria S: +perf, infra, product PM (Sam) and SRE for rollout constraints. 30-45m ok.

Jin W: I can do any morning PST except Wed. Need infra folks to confirm GPU availability for the runs we reference. @perf-bot will link the latest dashboard.

perf-bot: Latest perf dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/bench/inference-latency-cost?range=7d :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sam R: Agenda items from product side: 1) define acceptable p95 latency delta for canary, 2) cost target per 1M tokens, 3) fallback model choices.

Lina P: Two time options: Tue 9:00am PST (5:00pm UTC) or Thu 10:00am PST (6:00pm UTC). Which works?

Alex K: Throwing a quick poll — reply with the option that fits. Also add any extra agenda bullets. Proposed agenda:
- Quick status (5m)
- Latency + cost dashboard readout (10m)
- Quantization & batch config comparisons (10m)
- Canary rollout constraints & SRE checklist (10m)
- Action items + owners (5m)

Maria S: Tue 9 works for me. Add: please include a short table of perf vs quality for the quant runs (we already have evals but show diffs).

Jin W: Thu 10 is slightly better for infra. If we do Tue 9, infra can send someone but might be limited.

Sam R: Tue 9 is OK on my side. If infra can join remotely, fine — otherwise Thu 10 would be better.

Lina P: I'll coordinate with infra. Marking both as tentative, leaning Tue 9.

Alex K: OK let's tentatively book Tue 9:00am PST. If infra asks to move, we can flip to Thu. I'll send the calendar invite and include this Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000.

Sam R: Please add these items to the invite: required attendees (perf, infra lead, sam, lina, product), pre-reads (dashboard link + short CSV of key runs).

Alex K: Will attach pre-reads. Quick snippet of the command that produced the main numbers so folks can reproduce: 
```
python tools/run_bench.py --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --batch 8 --quant q4_0 --traces ./out/traces.json
```

Maria S: Nice. Also attach the tiny CSV with p50/p95/cost columns; example: 
```
model,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1M_tokens_usd
redwood-13b,q4_0,32,120,4.2
redwood-13b,fp16,28,95,6.8
```

Jin W: One ask for infra: please flag any expected schedule conflicts for maintenance windows next Tue morning.

Alex K: Noted. If anyone can't make the final time, reply here and I'll include notes + recording. :thumbsup:

Lina P: I'll confirm infra and post final invite by EOD today.

perf-bot: Added perf report snapshot to thread: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/bench/snapshots/17698

Alex K: Thanks — see you Tue (tentative). If anyone wants to pair on slides, ping me.

Sam R: I'll prep the cost slide and a short decision rubric for canary thresholds.

Maria S: I'll prep the quant quality diff table.

Jin W: Infra will try to join Tue; if not, we'll do Thu.

Lina P: Confirmed — inviting infra lead @Jorge and @Nina to the calendar as tentative.

Alex K: Closing — calendar invite sent (tentative). Last call for agenda items here.
